about: The graduale of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: This is the day the Lord made. Let us exult and rejoice in it. Give thanks to the Lord because He is good, because His mercy lasts forever.

ex.w014: The adjective is the predicate of an understood subject, the Lord, with the verb left out: “for [He is] good”.
